summary: Validated Employee Self-Service Portal feature (iteration 3) end-to-end. 20/20 new portal backend tests pass + 31/31 regression tests still green (51/51 total). Portal login, /portal/me, /portal/payslips (own only), /portal/payslip/{id} (ownership-enforced 404 for foreign slips), /portal/payslip/{id}/pdf (valid PDF), /portal/thr, and logout all work. Cross-auth isolation verified: admin access_token cannot reach /api/portal/* (401) and portal_token cannot reach /api/employees, /api/payroll/runs/{p}/slips, /api/auth/me (all 401). Both cookies coexist in same browser session and both APIs callable simultaneously. Frontend: /portal/login → /portal flow, payslip detail with Unduh PDF + Cetak + back link, logout redirect, and 'Masuk Portal Karyawan' link on admin /login all functional.

issues: Position · Department shown as 'IT · IT' for Syarifuddin because both fields are 'IT' in seed data — display is correct but visually awkward; not a bug, only a seed-data observation.

critical_code_review_comments: create_portal_token uses payload type='portal' with 24h expiry — get_current_employee validates type and rejects access_token (admin) tokens, preventing cross-contamination. Verified by test.
Portal endpoints correctly scope MongoDB queries by employee_id (e.g., db.payslips.find_one({'id': slip_id, 'employee_id': emp['id']})) — returns 404 for foreign slips, no IDOR. Verified.
PortalLogin requires BOTH NIK match AND email match on the SAME employee record (find by NIK then compare email) — prevents enumeration via NIK alone. Verified.
set_cookie uses httpOnly+SameSite=Lax for both access_token and portal_token cookies → safe coexistence (no clobbering).

Pre-existing CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is still present (carried from previous iterations). Browser blocks this combo only when cross-origin; same-origin proxy used in preview so not an active issue.
server.py is now 1618 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth/, portal/, payroll/, thr/, config/) for maintainability.
